$comment: Cue B of the score. A machine starting, not a tragedy unfolding.
title: Thirty-Seven Days

musical.notes: The ticking is the argument: thirty-seven days in which every actor had time to stop, and none did. Opens on the open fifth cue A leaves ringing, so the join can be a straight crossfade.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental underscore, 60 BPM, D minor. Muted chamber strings played close and cold; pizzicato ticking like a pocket watch, steady and slightly too loud; felt piano marking the same three-note figure underneath. A cimbalom heard once, far off, as if through a window. Air between the notes. Tension with no release. Ends suspended, no cadence.
